title: FROM TINY HATCHLINGS TO OCEAN GIANTS
caption: From the beach to the reef: the remarkable life of a green sea turtle. 🐢🌊 #GreenSeaTurtle #Wildlife #OceanLife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: A green sea turtle can spend years in the ocean. But where does that journey begin?
narration_timeline.scene: Open on an identifiable green sea turtle swimming underwater; no invented beach nesting.

narration_timeline.text: It begins on sandy shores, where tiny hatchlings must make their way toward the waves.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic green sea turtle hatchlings visibly crossing sand toward the sea; do not imply captive turtle is wild.

narration_timeline.text: Those that survive grow into powerful swimmers, moving through reefs and open water.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual adult green sea turtle swimming past reef or open water, without unrelated species.

narration_timeline.text: As they grow, green turtles can graze on algae and seagrass beneath the surface.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual scientific green turtle feeding on algal turf or seagrass; acknowledge scientific footage in credits.

narration_timeline.text: Protecting sea turtles also matters. Conservation centers help people understand the threats they face.
narration_timeline.scene: Documented turtle conservation center context; do not claim a specific rescue that is not shown.

narration_timeline.text: From tiny hatchlings on the beach to graceful swimmers at sea, every survivor has crossed two worlds.
narration_timeline.scene: End on close green sea turtle in open water, resolving the contrast with hatchling journey.
